The '''Mariposa People's Liberation Front''' ('''MPLF''') was the revolutionary movement associated with [[Ryszard Flak]] and the overthrow of the [[Kingdom of Mariposia]].

== Formation ==

Flak founded the movement in 1960 after several years of underground organizing. It united opposition factions around anti-monarchical politics, social justice, and a Taoist-inspired language of balance and liberation.

The MPLF drew from [[Taoism]], the [[Taoist Manifesto]], and the example of [[Xun Tao]] in [[People's Federation of Xanaqu|Xanaqu]], but it adapted those ideas to Mariposa's own monarchy, class structure, and political repression.

== Revolutionary Activity ==

The movement operated through clandestine meetings, underground publications, protest networks, and later armed insurrection. Flak's prison text, [[The Path to the Revolution]], became one of the movement's organizing documents after his 1964 arrest.

By 1975, the MPLF had moved from underground organization into open mass protest and armed conflict, beginning the revolutionary phase of the [[Mariposian Civil War]].

== After The Monarchy ==

The MPLF's efforts culminated in the 1980 fall of the monarchy and the establishment of the [[People's Republic of Mariposa]]. The movement's exact post-1980 relationship to the state, military, and later authoritarian turn is not yet confirmed.
